description: Layouts of the non-grid ('parameter') views: which text at which column is an instrument type, name, parameter, option or action. Column positions were measured on the manual's screenshots (font mode 0, 40 columns) and cross-checked with the phrase view grid; descriptions come from the manual.

notes.rows: A row is recognised by 'match' conditions on the line text (x = column, text = exact text, regex = pattern on the value.width chars). The first matching row wins; its cells give the field columns.
notes.zones: Views whose labels change (instrument parameters depend on the instrument type, modulation slots on the modulation type) use two label/value zones instead: the label text is read at labelX and the value at x. The label is then looked up in the vocabulary.
notes.formats: hex = 2 hex digits; hexOption = 2 hex digits followed by the option name ('00CHORUS'); hexPair = 'XX:YY'; decimal / decimalPair = base-10 numbers ('120', '150:45'); float = decimal with a fraction ('-05.00'); text = free text or option name; auto = detect from the text.
notes.unverified: Positions are read off the manual's screenshots, not from a device capture. Instrument-type specific layouts other than the Wavsynth header/parameter grid (Sampler SAMPLE row, FM operators, Hypersynth chord, MIDI CC rows) are only reached through the generic label/value zones.

cells.label: Tempo (TEMPO)
cells.description: Song speed in beats per minute. [EDIT] pressed rhythmically sets the tempo by tapping.

cells.label: Project Transpose (TRANSPOSE)
cells.description: Transposes the whole song in semitones (same as the TSP command). Only affects instruments with TRANSP. enabled; applied when [EDIT] is released.

cells.label: Default Groove (GROOVE)
cells.description: Groove used when the song plays (number and name); applied when [EDIT] is released. See Groove View.

cells.label: Default Scale (SCALE)
cells.description: Scale (number, key and name) used when the song plays; applied when [EDIT] is released. See Scale View.

cells.label: Live Quantize (LIVE QUANTIZE)
cells.description: How long a cued chain waits before starting when playing in live mode.

cells.label: MIDI Settings
cells.description: Open the MIDI Settings View.

cells.label: MIDI Mappings
cells.description: Open the MIDI Mappings View.

cells.label: Song Name (NAME)
cells.description: Name of the current song, entered before saving.

cells.label: Load Song
cells.description: Load a song from the SD card.

cells.label: Save Song
cells.description: Save the current song.

cells.label: New Song
cells.description: Create a new song.

cells.label: Render
cells.description: Open the Render View to render audio.

cells.label: Bundle
cells.description: Bundle the song with the instruments and samples it uses.

cells.label: Clear Unused Phrases
cells.description: Frees chains and phrases that are not used in the song.

cells.label: Clear Unused Instruments/Tables
cells.description: Frees instruments, EQs and tables that are not used in the song.

cells.label: View Instrument Pool
cells.description: Go to the Instrument Pool View.

cells.label: View Time Stats
cells.description: Open the Time Stats View (time spent on the song).

cells.label: System Settings
cells.description: Go to the System Settings View.

cells.label: USB Drive
cells.description: Puts the M8 in USB drive mode so SD card files can be transferred to a computer.

cells.label: Backlight (BACKLIGHT)
cells.description: Backlight LED brightness of the display.

cells.label: Font Options (FONT OPTIONS)
cells.description: Font settings, including a large font mode for readability.

cells.label: Theme (EDIT THEME)
cells.description: Open the Theme View.

cells.label: Note Preview (NOTE PREVIEW)
cells.description: Plays the note when editing notes in the phrase view.

cells.label: Recording Count-in (REC. COUNT IN)
cells.description: Number of phrases/measures of metronome count-in before recording audio in the Sample Editor or Selection to Sample.

cells.label: Metronome Volume (METRONOME VOL)
cells.description: Volume of the metronome sound (edit /System/Metronome.m8i to change the sound).

cells.label: Song Template (SAVE)
cells.description: Use the currently opened song as the template for new songs.

cells.label: Song Template (CLEAR)
cells.description: Clear the song template.

cells.label: USB Audio Mode (USB AUDIO MODE)
cells.description: USB output as stereo or multi-channel (multi-channel sends all 8 tracks and the effects individually, 12 stereo channels).

cells.label: USB Main Out (USB MAIN OUT)
cells.description: Routing behaviour of USB audio (see the USB audio routing options).

cells.label: Line-in Gate (LINE-IN GATE)
cells.description: Noise gate threshold for the line input, adjustable from -70 dB to -10 dB (OFF disables it).

cells.label: Splash Screen (SPLASH SCREEN)
cells.description: Show the M8 logo and play the start-up sound when turning on the device.

cells.label: Headphone Protection (HP PROTECTION)
cells.description: Limits the headphone output volume to F0 when a pack is unplugged and re-inserted.

cells.label: Key Delay:Repeat (KEY DELAY:REP)
cells.description: Key repeat timing in milliseconds: delay before a held key starts repeating, then the time between repeats.

cells.label: Battery Charging (BATT. CHARGING / STATUS)
cells.description: Whether the battery charges while the M8 is on and USB is connected (turn off to reduce power drawn from the host); also shows the current charging status.

cells.label: ModFX Type (MOD TYPE)
cells.description: ModFX effect: Chorus, Phaser or Flanger (also sets the phase position).

cells.label: Input EQ (INPUT EQ)
cells.description: Open the EQ editor for this effect's input.

cells.label: ModFX Mod Depth:Frequency (MOD DEPTH:FRQ)
cells.description: Amount of modulation in the stereo signal (first value) and speed of the modulation (second value).

cells.label: Stereo Width (STEREO WIDTH)
cells.description: Stereo width: 00 is mono, FF is stereo.

cells.label: Reverb Send (REVERB SEND)
cells.description: Amount of this effect sent to the reverb.

cells.label: Input EQ (INPUT EQ)
cells.description: Open the EQ editor for this effect's input.

cells.label: Delay Time L:R (TIME L:R)
cells.description: Delay time for the left and right channels: first digit in beats, second digit in fractions of a beat (40 is 4 beats).

cells.label: Feedback (FEEDBACK)
cells.description: Amount of the delayed signal fed back into the delay.

cells.label: Stereo Width (STEREO WIDTH)
cells.description: Stereo width: 00 is mono, FF is stereo.

cells.label: Reverb Send (REVERB SEND)
cells.description: Amount of this effect sent to the reverb.

cells.label: Input EQ (INPUT EQ)
cells.description: Open the EQ editor for this effect's input.

cells.label: Room Size (ROOM SIZE)
cells.description: Size of the reverb room.

cells.label: Reverb Decay:Shimmer (DECAY:SHIMMER)
cells.description: Reverb decay time (first value) and shimmer amount (second value).

cells.label: Reverb Mod Depth:Frequency (MOD DEPTH:FRQ)
cells.description: Reverb modulation depth (first value) and frequency (second value).

cells.label: Stereo Width (STEREO WIDTH)
cells.description: Stereo width: 00 is mono, FF is stereo.

cells.label: Speaker Volume (SPEAKER VOL)
cells.description: Volume of the built-in speaker.

cells.label: Output Volume (OUTPUT VOL)
cells.description: Volume of the audio output (headphones / line out).

cells.label: Track 1 Volume
cells.description: Volume of track 1. Instrument volumes are applied on top; the track's send levels are set in the instruments.

cells.label: Track 2 Volume
cells.description: Volume of track 2.

cells.label: Track 3 Volume
cells.description: Volume of track 3.

cells.label: Track 4 Volume
cells.description: Volume of track 4.

cells.label: Track 5 Volume
cells.description: Volume of track 5.

cells.label: Track 6 Volume
cells.description: Volume of track 6.

cells.label: Track 7 Volume
cells.description: Volume of track 7.

cells.label: Track 8 Volume
cells.description: Volume of track 8.

cells.label: Main Mix EQ (EQ)
cells.description: Open the main mix EQ editor ([EDIT] or [SHIFT]+[RIGHT]).

cells.label: ModFX Volume (MX)
cells.description: Output level of the ModFX send effect.

cells.label: Delay Volume (DE)
cells.description: Output level of the delay send effect.

cells.label: Reverb Volume (RE)
cells.description: Output level of the reverb send effect.

cells.label: Analog Input Volume (INPUT)
cells.description: Volume of the analog input for monitoring. In dual-mono mode this is the left channel.

cells.label: Analog Input Volume, 2nd channel
cells.description: Enables dual-mono input mode when set (right channel volume); clear with [EDIT]+[OPTION] to disable.

cells.label: USB Input Volume (USB)
cells.description: Volume of anything the USB host computer sends to the M8.

cells.label: Main Volume (MIX)
cells.description: Main song volume, applied after the limiter, DJ filter and OTT. [EDIT] or [SHIFT]+[RIGHT] opens the Mix Scope.

cells.label: Limiter (LIM)
cells.description: Main mix limiter amount; the limiter is engaged when the value is above 00. [EDIT] or [SHIFT]+[RIGHT] opens the Limiter Scope.

cells.label: Analog Input ModFX Send (INPUT MX)
cells.description: How much of the analog input goes to the ModFX effect.

cells.label: USB Input ModFX Send (USB MX)
cells.description: How much of the USB input goes to the ModFX effect.

cells.label: DJ Filter (DJF)
cells.description: DJ filter cutoff: 80 is off, below 80 low-pass (or band-stop), above 80 high-pass. Mode and options are in the Scope View.

cells.label: Analog Input Delay Send (INPUT DE)
cells.description: How much of the analog input goes to the delay effect.

cells.label: USB Input Delay Send (USB DE)
cells.description: How much of the USB input goes to the delay effect.

cells.label: OTT (OTT)
cells.description: Over The Top multi-band compression mixed in parallel: 00 to 80 mixes it in; from 80 and above the main mix is faded out.

cells.label: Analog Input Reverb Send (INPUT RE)
cells.description: How much of the analog input goes to the reverb effect.

cells.label: USB Input Reverb Send (USB RE)
cells.description: How much of the USB input goes to the reverb effect.

cells.label: LOW Gain
cells.description: Boost (positive) or cut (negative) applied by the LOW band, in decibels.

cells.label: MID Gain
cells.description: Boost (positive) or cut (negative) applied by the MID band, in decibels.

cells.label: HIGH Gain
cells.description: Boost (positive) or cut (negative) applied by the HIGH band, in decibels.

cells.label: LOW Frequency
cells.description: Centre (or corner) frequency of the LOW band.

cells.label: MID Frequency
cells.description: Centre (or corner) frequency of the MID band.

cells.label: HIGH Frequency
cells.description: Centre (or corner) frequency of the HIGH band.

cells.label: LOW Q
cells.description: Quality factor (bandwidth) of the LOW band: higher values narrow it.

cells.label: MID Q
cells.description: Quality factor (bandwidth) of the MID band: higher values narrow it.

cells.label: HIGH Q
cells.description: Quality factor (bandwidth) of the HIGH band: higher values narrow it.

cells.label: LOW Type
cells.description: Filter shape of the LOW band.

options.LOWSHELF: Boosts or cuts frequencies below the shelf frequency.
options.BELL: Peaking filter: boosts or cuts around the centre frequency.
options.BANDPASS: Passes frequencies around the centre frequency, attenuating both sides.
options.HI.SHELF: Boosts or cuts frequencies above the shelf frequency.
options.HI.CUT: Attenuates or removes frequencies above the cutoff.
options.ALLPASS: Passes all frequencies at equal gain while shifting their phase.

cells.label: MID Type
cells.description: Filter shape of the MID band.

options.LOWSHELF: Boosts or cuts frequencies below the shelf frequency.
options.BELL: Peaking filter: boosts or cuts around the centre frequency.
options.BANDPASS: Passes frequencies around the centre frequency, attenuating both sides.
options.HI.SHELF: Boosts or cuts frequencies above the shelf frequency.
options.HI.CUT: Attenuates or removes frequencies above the cutoff.
options.ALLPASS: Passes all frequencies at equal gain while shifting their phase.

cells.label: HIGH Type
cells.description: Filter shape of the HIGH band.

options.LOWSHELF: Boosts or cuts frequencies below the shelf frequency.
options.BELL: Peaking filter: boosts or cuts around the centre frequency.
options.BANDPASS: Passes frequencies around the centre frequency, attenuating both sides.
options.HI.SHELF: Boosts or cuts frequencies above the shelf frequency.
options.HI.CUT: Attenuates or removes frequencies above the cutoff.
options.ALLPASS: Passes all frequencies at equal gain while shifting their phase.

cells.label: LOW Mode
cells.description: How the LOW band is applied to the stereo signal.

options.SIDE: Affects only the side information (difference between left and right).

cells.label: MID Mode
cells.description: How the MID band is applied to the stereo signal.

options.SIDE: Affects only the side information (difference between left and right).

cells.label: HIGH Mode
cells.description: How the HIGH band is applied to the stereo signal.

options.SIDE: Affects only the side information (difference between left and right).

cells.label: Limiter Attack (ATK)
cells.description: Limiter attack time from 0 to 100 ms (see the on-screen help text for the conversion to milliseconds).

cells.label: Limiter Release (REL)
cells.description: Limiter release time from 4 to 1000 ms; 00 activates AUTO mode (100-900 ms depending on the compression amount).

cells.label: Limiter (LIM)
cells.description: Limiter amount.

cells.label: Zoom (ZOOM)
cells.description: Lower limit of the scope histogram, in decibels.

cells.label: Peak (PEAK)
cells.description: Current peak level of the main mix in dB. Resets when MIX or LIM change; clear it with [OPT]+[EDIT].

cells.label: Main Mix EQ (EQ)
cells.description: Open the main mix EQ editor.

cells.label: Soft Clip (SOFT CLIP)
cells.description: Gentle saturation after the limiter to prevent harsh clipping; raise MIX to exaggerate it.

cells.label: Main Volume (MIX)
cells.description: Main mix / song volume, applied after the limiter stage.

cells.label: Main Volume (MIX)
cells.description: Main mix / song volume, applied after the limiter stage.

cells.label: Limiter (LIM)
cells.description: Limiter amount.

cells.label: DJ Filter (DJF)
cells.description: DJ filter cutoff: 80 is off, 00-80 low-pass, 80-FF high-pass (mode set with TYPE).

cells.label: OTT (OTT)
cells.description: OTT mix amount; from 80 and above the main mix volume is faded out.

ATK.label: Limiter Attack (ATK)
ATK.description: Limiter attack time from 0 to 100 ms (see the on-screen help text for the conversion).

REL.label: Limiter Release (REL)
REL.description: Limiter release time from 4 to 1000 ms; 00 activates AUTO mode (100-900 ms depending on the compression amount).

TYPE.label: DJ Filter Type (TYPE)
TYPE.description: DJ filter type: low-pass/high-pass, low-pass/band-stop or band-stop/high-pass.

TIME.label: OTT Time (TIME)
TIME.description: OTT compressor envelope time as a percentage from 10% to 1000%.

COLOR.label: OTT Color (COLOR)
COLOR.description: OTT compressor bands and low/high gains: above 80 shifts toward treble, below 80 toward bass.

cells.label: Instrument Type (TYPE)
cells.description: Kind of instrument in this slot: Wavsynth, Macrosynth, Sampler, FM Synth, Hypersynth, External Instrument, MIDI Out (or NONE for an unused slot). Changing it changes the parameters below.

cells.label: Load Preset (LOAD)
cells.description: Load an instrument preset from the SD card.

cells.label: Save Preset (SAVE)
cells.description: Save this instrument as a preset on the SD card.

cells.label: Instrument Name (NAME)
cells.description: Name of the instrument: helps keep the song organised when browsing, saving or bundling instruments.

cells.label: Transpose Enabled (TRANSP.)
cells.description: Enable or disable note transposition from scales, chain transpose columns and the project transpose for this instrument (turn off for percussive or effect instruments).

cells.label: Table Tick (TBL. TIC)
cells.description: Default speed at which this instrument's table advances: 01 is one tick per step, 02 two ticks per step. Can be overridden by the TIC command.

cells.label: EQ Slot (EQ)
cells.description: EQ bank assigned to this instrument (-- for none). [EDIT] or [SHIFT]+[RIGHT] opens the EQ editor.

MOD#.label: Modulator Type
MOD#.description: Type of this modulation slot: AHD envelope, ADSR envelope, DRUM envelope, LFO, TRIG envelope or TRACKING. Slots can modulate their neighbour (Mod 1 affects Mod 2, 2→3, 3→4, 4→1).

options.AHD ENV: Attack Hold Decay envelope based on tempo.
options.ADSR ENV: Traditional Attack Decay Sustain Release envelope.
options.DRUM ENV: Sharp peak and swelling hold envelope for percussive elements.
options.TRIG ENV: AHD envelope triggered by another playing track or instrument.
options.TRACKING: Modulates an instrument parameter from notes or velocities.

DEST.label: Destination (DEST)
DEST.description: Instrument parameter this modulator controls. MOD AMT, MOD RATE or MOD BOTH modulate the neighbouring modulator's amount, rate or both.

SRC.label: Source (SRC)
SRC.description: Modulation source. Trig envelope: an instrument number (00-7F) or a whole track (80-87 = tracks 1-8). Tracking: NOTE, VELOCITY or VELOCITY TAKEOVER (velocity no longer affects instrument volume).

AMT.label: Amount (AMT)
AMT.description: How strongly the modulator is applied to the destination.

ATK.label: Attack (ATK)
ATK.description: Time to reach the amount (in ticks, relative to tempo).

HOLD.label: Hold (HOLD)
HOLD.description: Time to wait after the attack before decaying (in ticks).

DEC.label: Decay (DEC)
DEC.description: Time to fall back (AHD/Drum: to zero; ADSR: to the sustain level), in ticks.

SUS.label: Sustain (SUS)
SUS.description: Level held while the note is playing (ADSR).

REL.label: Release (REL)
REL.description: Time to fall back to zero after the note is released (ADSR); needs an OFF note or FX command.

PEAK.label: Peak (PEAK)
PEAK.description: Shape of the initial transient (drum envelope); modifies the duck amount and peak time.

BODY.label: Body (BODY)
BODY.description: Time to hold the modulation before decaying (drum envelope).

OSC.label: LFO Shape (OSC)
OSC.description: LFO shape: triangle, sine, ramp down/up, exponential down/up, square down/up, random, drunk. The 'T' variants run in ticks (much faster).

TRIG.label: LFO Trigger (TRIG)
TRIG.description: How the LFO reacts when the instrument triggers and when the shape ends.

options.FREE: Loop the shape and don't reset on new notes.
options.RETRIG: Loop the shape and reset on each instrument trigger.
options.HOLD: Hold the last value of the shape.
options.ONCE: Play the shape once and reset to the start value.

FREQ.label: LFO Frequency (FREQ)
FREQ.description: Rate of the LFO in steps (16th notes), or in ticks for the 'T' shapes.

LVAL.label: Low Value (LVAL)
LVAL.description: Lowest value of the source range scaled to the destination (tracking). Can be higher than HVAL to invert the range.

HVAL.label: High Value (HVAL)
HVAL.description: Highest value of the source range scaled to the destination (tracking).

scale.notes: Only the rows below the 12 interval rows; the intervals themselves are grid columns in m8-view-context.json.

cells.label: Key (KEY)
cells.description: Global key: the root note of the default scale (can be overridden per track with SCA / SCG).

cells.label: Tuning (TUNE)
cells.description: Reference pitch of A4 in Hz (440.00 is standard).

cells.label: Scale Name (NAME)
cells.description: Name of this scale (up to 16 characters); 92 factory scales load from /Scales/Factory.

cells.label: Load Scale (LOAD)
cells.description: Load a scale from the SD card.

cells.label: Save Scale (SAVE)
cells.description: Save this scale to the SD card.

createdirectory.description: Name of the directory to create on the SD card.

common.name: Common
common.description: Parameters shared by most instrument types.

FILTER.label: Filter Type (FILTER)
FILTER.description: Multi-mode filter type: low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, band-stop, LP>HP (low-pass with RES controlling a 1-pole high-pass), ZDF low-pass, ZDF high-pass.

AMP.label: Amplification (AMP)
AMP.description: Amplifies the signal; values above the maximum level are handled according to LIM.

LIM.label: Limit Mode (LIM)
LIM.description: Limit / clipping behaviour of the amplified signal.

options.CLIP: Values above the maximum level are clipped.
options.SIN: The waveform is fed through a sine function.
options.FOLD: Values above the maximum level are folded back into themselves.
options.WRAP: Values above the maximum level are wrapped vertically.
options.POST: Amplification applied with hard-clipping after the filter stage.

PAN.label: Pan (PAN)
PAN.description: Stereo position of the instrument (80 is centre).

DRY.label: Dry Volume (DRY)
DRY.description: Dry volume sent to the mixer channel.

wavsynth.name: Wavsynth
wavsynth.description: Wave table synthesizer and noise generator: an 8-bit sample buffer generated in real time from one of 9 basic shapes (repeated, skewed, mirrored, filtered, overdriven) or one of 61 built-in wave tables of 64 waveforms each.

SHAPE.label: Shape (SHAPE)
SHAPE.description: Base waveform: PULSE 12% to 75%, SAW, TRIANGLE, SINE, NOISE PITCHED, NOISE, or WT wave tables. For PWM set PULSE 50% and adjust MIRROR (smoothness set by SIZE).

SIZE.label: Size (SIZE)
SIZE.description: Horizontal size of the waveform (number of samples).

MULT.label: Multiply (MULT)
MULT.description: Multiplies the waveform by adding repeats of the shape; can sound like hard sync.

WARP.label: Warp (WARP)
WARP.description: Pushes the shape to one side of the wave table.

SCAN.label: Scan / Mirror (SCAN)
SCAN.description: Shapes 0-8: mirrors the waveform at the given position (0-200%). Wave tables: scans through the 64 waveforms.

FILTER.label: Filter Type (FILTER)
FILTER.description: Multi-mode filter type, plus 4 modes that apply the filter into the waveform: WAV LP, WAV HP, WAV BP, WAV BS.

macrosynth.name: Macrosynth
macrosynth.description: 44 engines ('shapes') from basic analog to 2-op FM, physical modelling and percussion; TIMBRE and COLOR change meaning per shape.

SHAPE.label: Shape (SHAPE)
SHAPE.description: One of the 44 Macrosynth engines (see the Macrosynth Models appendix).

TIMBRE.label: Timbre (TIMBRE)
TIMBRE.description: First parameter of the selected shape.

COLOR.label: Color (COLOR)
COLOR.description: Second parameter of the selected shape.

sampler.name: Sampler
sampler.description: Sample player, editor and recorder for 1 or 2 channel PCM .wav files.

SAMPLE.label: Sample (SAMPLE)
SAMPLE.description: The loaded sample; use LOAD to browse for one, REC. to record or EDIT to open the Sample Editor.

SLICE.label: Slice (SLICE)
SLICE.description: Slices the sample into equal sections, mapped from the lowest octave (C-1); 01 FILE uses the markers stored in the file.

options.OSC: Oscillator mode: ignores the start position and doesn't restart on retrigger.
options.REPITCH: Pitches the sample from the song tempo (adjust with STEPS/BPM).

START.label: Start (START)
START.description: Sample start position (ignored in OSC play modes).

LOOP ST..label: Loop Start (LOOP ST.)
LOOP ST..description: Where the sample loops back to when it reaches the end in a looping play mode.

DETUNE.label: Detune (DETUNE)
DETUNE.description: Detune with 80 as the centre frequency: first digit steps semitones, second digit 1/16 semitone.

DEGRADE.label: Degrade (DEGRADE)
DEGRADE.description: Sample rate reduction; any value above 00 disables sample interpolation.

fmsynth.name: FM Synth
fmsynth.description: Four-operator, 12-algorithm FM synthesizer. Each operator has a base shape, ratio, level, feedback and two modulation slots.

ALGO.label: Algorithm (ALGO)
ALGO.description: One of 12 algorithms (oscillator routing); the last one is additive mode.

A.label: Operator A (A)
A.description: Operator letter with optional shape (SIN, SW2-SW6, SAW, SQU, PUL, IMP, TRI, NOISE, then wave tables).

RATIO.label: Ratio (RATIO)
RATIO.description: Operator frequency ratio relative to the played note (2.00 is an octave up, 0.50 an octave down).

MOD.label: Modulation Slot (MOD)
MOD.description: Assigns one of MOD1-MOD4 to control a destination on the operator.

LEV.label: Level Mod (LEV)
LEV.description: Controls the level from 00 to the currently set level.

RAT.label: Ratio Mod (RAT)
RAT.description: Adds 0.00 to +16.00 to the current ratio.

PIT.label: Pitch Mod (PIT)
PIT.description: Adds to the note pitch, in semitones, for the operator.

FBK.label: Feedback Mod (FBK)
FBK.description: Controls feedback from 00 to the currently set feedback.

MOD#.label: Modulation Source
MOD#.description: Modulation source value freely assigned to operators through the MOD slots.

hypersynth.name: Hypersynth
hypersynth.description: Six-note saw wave chord synthesizer with 16 chord banks of up to 6 intervals, detune (swarm), stereo width and a square sub-oscillator.

SCALE.label: Scale (SCALE)
SCALE.description: One of the song's scales, or 00 to use the song/track scale settings.

CHORD.label: Chord (CHORD)
CHORD.description: Chord bank and its intervals (copy with [SHIFT]+[OPTION], paste with [SHIFT]+[EDIT]).

SHIFT.label: Shift (SHIFT)
SHIFT.description: Cross-fades volume between the first 3 intervals and the second 3.

SWARM.label: Swarm (SWARM)
SWARM.description: Detunes the oscillators relative to their interval.

WIDTH.label: Stereo Width (WIDTH)
WIDTH.description: Stereo width of the oscillators, from mono 00 to full stereo FF.

SUBOSC.label: Sub Oscillator (SUBOSC)
SUBOSC.description: Mixes in a sub-oscillator 2 octaves below the root (below 80) or 1 octave below (above 80).

external.name: External Instrument
external.description: Hybrid MIDI output and audio input device: notes and MIDI FX are sent to the chosen port and channel, audio returns through its filter and amp stage.

INPUT.label: Audio Input (INPUT)
INPUT.description: Audio input: line-in (stereo, left, right), USB (stereo, left, right), or line-in and USB.

PORT.label: MIDI Port (PORT)
PORT.description: MIDI output port: MIDI and USB, MIDI only, USB only, or Internal (track MIDI input / global MIDI CCs from the MIDI Settings View).

BANK:PG.label: Bank / Program (BANK:PG)
BANK:PG.description: Optional MIDI bank select and program change (program change can also be sent as an FX command).

CC#.label: Custom CC (CC:VAL)
CC#.description: A custom MIDI CC number with an optional default value, sent with the note-on after program change messages.

midiout.name: MIDI Out
midiout.description: Controls external devices over USB MIDI or the TRS (type A) MIDI output.

PORT.label: MIDI Port (PORT)
PORT.description: MIDI output port: MIDI and USB, MIDI only, USB only, or Internal (track MIDI input / global MIDI CCs from the MIDI Settings View).

BANK:PG.label: Bank / Program (BANK:PG)
BANK:PG.description: Optional MIDI bank select and program change (program change can also be sent as an FX command).

CC#.label: Custom CC (CC:VAL)
CC#.description: One of up to 10 custom MIDI CC numbers per instrument with an optional default value, sent with the note-on after program change messages.
